model.name: Add folder SUCCEEDS on a model collection (route to model-store when no physical dir) — truthful applicability, offered implies succeeds
model.description: Tron ruling (reported MULTIPLE TIMES; architect design 5cfa4f9dd): Add folder must SUCCEED on a model collection like diagrams, NOT be suppressed — suppressing recreates the sometimes-a-button behaviour he explicitly rejected. ROOT: the model endpoint routes EVERY add-folder through the PHYSICAL create path, which returns the error bad-parent-loc for a parent with no real directory (the uncovered THIRD bad-parent-loc cause = a virtual Folder with no physical dir). FIX is ROUTING: branch to the MODEL-STORE create when the parent has no physical dir (both paths already exist). DOCTRINE (the valuable part): a Folder unit is a MODEL OBJECT, not inherently a directory; we assumed folder == directory and THAT assumption is the defect. TRUTHFUL APPLICABILITY: if we offer a verb it must succeed — offered implies succeeds by construction. The literal error Tron sees: bad-parent-loc.

R40.83 room-folder dual-identity + R40.82 folder-owns-children (folder is a model object) = the containment family. Tracked defect c83c02f2 is the ONE home for Tron repeat reports (carries the error string).

model.doctrineReconciliation: MEASURE-BEATS-RELAY (robbin-req, from R40.37 on disk): the folder != directory doctrine was NOT a naive original assumption — R40.37 AC-ADD-FOLDER-MINTS-REAL-UNIT-IMMEDIATELY already ruled it on 2026-08-12 (Tron: physical = a real PERSISTED unit, NOT a filesystem directory, NO mkdir). The assumption was RE-INTRODUCED by the R40.78 room-physical-folder work (Files IS the room physical folder -> createPhysicalWithUnit does mkdir). Applying that PHYSICAL-create path to MODEL collections (diagrams, no physical dir) is what returns bad-parent-loc. So R40.87 is not a new doctrine — it RECONCILES R40.37 (unit-only path, virtual parent) with R40.78 (physical path, room parent) by ROUTING on parent physicality: physical dir -> physical create (R40.78); no physical dir -> model-store unit create (R40.37). Both paths already exist; the endpoint must branch, not force every add through physical.
